summary: Recorded the retained multi-requester receipt (9217afa8): with three remote reads queued from two nodes and one tick-driven confirmation, both earlier reads stayed at index zero and did not complete while only the newest completed, including one node's earlier read stalling while its later read succeeded. All four comparisons completed in that run. Added the corresponding fact, cited the receipt in the primary interpretation, widened the rationale to a batch, noted in counterevidence that the newest read completes under the same confirmation, and replaced the limitation that several remote requesters had not been measured. The earlier version of this experiment reused one result event per three requesters and is not cited. Validation reports valid, no_change false, no execution requested.
